verses.1: For since the law of future blessings exists, it is impossible for her to represent those things that are offered as sacrifices during the festival days. Thus, those who come forward cannot be completely satisfied with these offerings.
verses.2: Since they would not stop offering these things, because there is still no awareness of any sins among those who worship them.
verses.3: But in them is the memory of sins committed over the years.
verses.4: For it is impossible to remove the blood and other substances from the body due to sin.
verses.5: Therefore, entering into the world, he says: “I do not accept sacrifices or offerings. But I will demand a body from you.”
verses.6: I did not approve of those acts of redemption and forgiveness related to sins.
verses.7: Then I said, “Look, there’s written in the head of this book about me, about how God has fulfilled His will.”
verses.8: Above all, I said that sacrifices, offerings, and other rituals related to sins were not acceptable or desirable. These are things that, according to the law, should not be offered.
verses.9: Then he said, “Now, I will help you carry out your desire. First, I will remove the first part, so that you can proceed with the second part.”
verses.10: They were chosen by God’s will, through the offering of Jesus Christ’s body.
verses.11: And every priest stood before God to perform his duties, offering the same sacrifices over and over again. But these sacrifices never can cover the sins of anyone.
verses.12: But this one, having offered a sacrifice for his sins, stood in front of the god during the festival, to the right of the god.
verses.13: The rest of it will be taken care of until his enemies can step under his feet.
verses.14: For they will offer sacrifices during the festival days, so that those who are holy may be blessed.
verses.15: And the holy Spirit also testifies to us, after all that has been said.
verses.16: This is the covenant I will make with them after those days are over, says the Lord. I will establish my laws in their hearts, and I will also record their thoughts in my book.
verses.17: And I will not forget their sins and their unrighteousness either.
verses.18: But where such things are given up, it is no longer a matter of offering sacrifices for sins.
verses.19: Therefore, brothers, take pleasure in the entrance into the holy place through the blood of Jesus.
verses.20: What has recently been destroyed in our path, and what has died because of that decree… This is the nature of its flesh.
verses.21: and a great priest upon the house of God,
verses.22: We will enter through a true heart, filled with faith. Our hearts will be freed from evil thoughts, and our bodies will be cleansed by pure water.
verses.23: We hold the promise of hope intact, for the person who made this promise is trustworthy.
verses.24: And let us understand each other through the expression of love and good deeds.
verses.25: Do not abandon the practice of self-discipline, as is the custom among people who follow such practices. Instead, continue to practice it, and do so more often, as you see fit.
verses.26: For surely, after we have been caught in the act of sinning, the sacrifice of truth is no longer possible for those who are guilty of sin.
verses.27: One must fear the terrifying prospect of judgment and fire that awaited those who opposed them.
verses.28: Whoever violates the laws of Moses without proper reasons or without three witnesses, shall die.
verses.29: How much seem you think that the son of God deserves punishment for having sinned against him? And how much do you think he deserves to be punished for breaking the covenant he made with God, and for using the blood of that covenant as a sacrifice?
verses.30: We know who the questioner is. I will defend myself in court. Again, the king is judging the people.
verses.31: It’s terrifying to be trapped in the hands of a living God.
verses.32: Remember those previous days, when you were subjected to many hardships and suffering during those times when you were exposed to fire.
verses.33: One group was filled with envy and sorrow; the other group became involved in this situation.
verses.34: And indeed, you endured the hardships associated with those bonds, and you willingly accepted the losses that came with them. You knew that you were in a difficult situation, but you remained steadfast.
verses.35: Therefore, do not give up your opportunity to work, since it offers a great reward.
verses.36: For you have the patience necessary to carry out God’s will and thus fulfill His commandment.
verses.37: For as little as it may be, the one who comes will still arrive, and he won’t wait long.
verses.38: But my friend who lives by faith will live in peace. And if he is killed, my soul will not be at ease with him.
verses.39: We, however, are not under a mission of loss, but rather under a mission of strengthening our souls through faith.
